text:
Devon: Heads up — cloud partner asked for a 'triangle credit' clause in private offers if customer shifts committed spend toward hardware bundling. Need quick take.
Priya: triangle credit? can you paste the ask? 
Devon: They want 15% of remaining commit credited back to SI partner if customer moves 40%+ of consumption to HW within 12 months. They claim it keeps channel economics whole. 
Ravi: Hmm that creates double-dipping risk — we'd be refunding customer credits + giving partner credit. Need guardrails. 
Sofia: Agree. We could do a true-up model: if HW move > threshold then convert remaining commit to HW SKU at a discounted conversion rate instead of straight credit. 
Priya: +1 to true-up. Also add a cap on partner credit (e.g., max 25% of original commit). 
Devon: Partner insists on simple math. They want a clause like: "if >40% shift to HW then partner receives 15% of unused committed $ as credit toward joint SI services." 
Ravi: Can we propose a 2-step: 1) eligible only for first renewal window; 2) partner credits escrowed and paid after renewal conversion validated. 
Sofia: Operationally, we need event triggers: how do we detect the move? marketplace-bot: Usage delta alert: customer ACME-Corp moved 47% of 30d consumption to HW-sku-XL as of 1765439900. 
Devon: Nice — that example helps. If we accept, need contract language + product flow: private-offer footprint update, committed spend conversion, partner credit ledger entry. 
Priya: Legal flags: avoid unconditional refunds. Also ensure credits can't be stacked with onboarding credits. 
Ravi: Pricing ops: implement conversion rate table. sample snippet:
```
if hw_shift_pct >= 40:
  partner_credit = min(0.15 * remaining_commit, cap)
  convert_remaining = remaining_commit * conversion_rate
```
Sofia: We should also timebox offer: only for private offers executed between 2026-01-01 and 2027-01-01, pilot-only. 
Devon: Agree pilot first. Who owns partner comms? @Priya you ok to propose the pilot terms and a short joint FAQ for SI? 
Priya: I can draft. Will include: eligibility, detection, cap, payout timing, sample calc, example scenarios. ETA EOD tomorrow. 
Ravi: I'll map ops implications and drop a Jira for conversion table + ledger changes. 
Sofia: I'll coordinate with HW partner PM on joint announcement cadence — we don't want a public marketplace listing until pilot metrics look good. 
Devon: Thanks team. Quick poll: :thumbsup: pilot with true-up + cap, :thumbsdown: no. 
Priya: :thumbsup: 
Ravi: :thumbsup: 
Sofia: :thumbsup: 
Devon: :thumbsup: 
marketplace-bot: Created ticket MAP-4312 for "triangle credit pilot - conversion flow" assigned to Ravi. Link: https://tracker.redwood.ai/MAP-4312 
Devon: moving to close — Priya pls ping when draft ready, Ravi pls link ops tickets here. 
Priya: Will do. 
Ravi: Linked MAP-4312 and MAP-4313 (ledger) in thread. 
Sofia: noted — keeping announcement hold until 1 month post-pilot review. 
Devon: done. Thanks. :sparkles:
